fusions.name: Fetched Driftwood
fusions.desc: Throws a length of driftwood at a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill fetches one back.

fusions.name: Herding Circle
fusions.desc: Circles the enemies around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Guarded Flank
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. An escort of hounds fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shore Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound keeps to your side, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds, and each kill it makes restores 3 health to you.
